none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained convex quadratic minimization: f(x)-f(u)=½⟨x-u,H̄(x-u)⟩, where H̄=Σ_i π_i H_i and 0≤H_i≤LI. Strong convexity is not required.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: The population objective is a finite, probability-weighted sum of quadratic component losses. The number of components m, weights π, operators H_i, and common minimizer u are hidden.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call at x returns H_i(x-u), with i sampled along an exogenous finite-state Markov chain. Its stationary mean is ∇f(x), but conditional unbiasedness is not assumed. The oracle returns only the gradient vector; component indices and transition information are hidden.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: Replies are exact gradients of the sampled quadratic components. The algorithm cannot select the component; consecutive calls advance the Markov trajectory.

distinctive_assumptions.label: markov_dependence
distinctive_assumptions.details: The chain has invariant distribution π and arbitrary initial distribution μ. Its transition kernel satisfies κ(i,{j})≥απ({j}) for every i,j, with public 0<α≤1. Reversibility and stationary initialization are not required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Exact interpolation: every component gradient vanishes at the same hidden u. Each H_i is bounded, self-adjoint and positive semidefinite, with 0≤⟨x,H_i x⟩≤L‖x‖². The ambient space is a complete real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure and second-countable topology. E,L,x0,α are public; R and ε are hidden analysis parameters, with L>0, R≥0, ε>0 and ‖x0-u‖≤R.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/MarkovQuadraticInterpolation.lean: Public, Params, Model.symmetric, Model.positive, Model.smooth, Model.radius, spec.publicInput, spec.valid; LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvex.lean: Gradient.Public.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output must be measurable and have integrable excess objective value relative to a global minimizer u. No last-iterate or averaging restriction is imposed by successful.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[f(output)-f(u)]≤ε under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness. Oracle cost is bounded for every seed by the fixed budget ⌈10¹⁶LR²/(αε)⌉+1.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/MarkovQuadraticInterpolation.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence; supplied extracted budget for OracleTemplate.MarkovQuadratic.result.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Convex quadratic interpolation is combined with a hidden Markov component-gradient oracle, arbitrary chain initialization, and a public one-step stationary minorization parameter in a potentially infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.
